name: LubinTateDeformationSpaceConstraintCanonical
description: Formal group height uniqueness and deformation ring structure via cvc5+sympy

pytorch.reason: pytorch not needed; pure symbolic/algebraic computation via cvc5 and sympy

pyg.reason: PyG message passing not needed; constraint geometry handled via SMT solver

z3.reason: z3 not needed; cvc5 handles all SMT constraint proofs in this sim

cvc5.reason: cvc5 SMT solver (QF_LIA): load_bearing proof of formal group deformation constraints; height uniqueness, ring structure, parameter independence

sympy.reason: sympy: supportive symbolic algebra for formal group logarithm formulas and deformation ring element expansion

clifford.reason: Clifford algebra not needed; p-adic number-theoretic constraints only

geomstats.reason: geomstats not needed; no differential geometry in this sim

e3nn.reason: e3nn not needed; no SO(3) equivariance required

rustworkx.reason: rustworkx not needed; no graph structure in this sim

xgi.reason: xgi not needed; pairwise interactions only

toponetx.reason: toponetx not needed; standard algebraic ops sufficient

gudhi.reason: gudhi not needed; no persistent homology in this sim

test_1_height_uniqueness.description: Height n implies n-1 deformation parameters

test_2_logarithm_normalization.description: log_F(x) = Σ x^{p^k}/p^k satisfies p-adic normalization

test_3_deformation_ring_structure.description: Deformation ring R_n = W(F_{p^n})[[u_1,...,u_{n-1}]] with correct structure

test_1_param_count_violation.description: UNSAT: height n with n parameters (should have n-1)

test_2_incompatible_heights.description: UNSAT: two distinct heights in single deformation space

test_3_parameter_independence_bound.description: UNSAT: more algebraically independent params than ring supports

test_1_height_zero.description: Edge case: height 0 has 0 deformation parameters

test_2_logarithm_precision.description: Logarithm series with finite degree truncation

test_3_large_prime_small_height.description: Constraint holds for large primes and small heights
